questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -3\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ -{x}_{1} \\ 0\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}2{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3} \\ -3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3} \\ -{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}+{x}_{3} \\ -{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=1 \\ -{x}_{1}+3{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=0 \\ -{x}_{2}-3{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 2 & 1 \\ -1 & 3 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & -1 & -3 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 2 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+2{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=1 \\ 0=2.\end{aligned}
$$

 

However, the final equation $0=2$  gives a false statement. So the system has no solution.

questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -5 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 11 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 4\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ -5 \\ -1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 11 \\ -2\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ 4{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} \\ -5{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{3} \\ 11{x}_{3} \\ -2{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3} \\ -5{x}_{2}+11{x}_{3} \\ 4{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -4 \\ 15\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=2 \\ -5{x}_{2}+11{x}_{3}=-4 \\ 4{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=15\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4 \\ 4 & -1 & -2 & 15\end{aligned}]
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4 \\ 4 & -1 & -2 & 15\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-4{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4 \\ 0 & 7 & -14 & -7\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & ↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 7 & -14 & -7 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{7}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 11 & -4\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+5{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 3 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, the system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=2 \\ {x}_{2}-2{x}_{3}=1 \\ {x}_{3}=1.\end{aligned}
$$

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=1.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
{x}_{2}-2(1)=1\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=3.
$$

Finally, by substituting ${x}_{2}=3$ and ${x}_{3}=1$  into the first equation, we obtain

$$
{x}_{1}-2(3)+3(1)=2\,⟹\,{x}_{1}=5.
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=5$, ${x}_{2}=3$, and ${x}_{3}=1,$ which means 

$$
5{a}_{1}+3{a}_{2}+{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=5+3+1=9.
$$

questions.problem:
Consider the vectors

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ -1 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -2 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b,$ then what is ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}?$
questions.worked_solution:
If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 0 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ -1 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -2 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ -2{x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}-8{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2} \\ 4{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -2 \\ -2\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-8{x}_{2} \\ -{x}_{2} \\ -2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -2 \\ -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-8{x}_{2}=-1 \\ -{x}_{2}=-2 \\ -2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=-2\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation we get ${x}_{2}=2$, which we substitute into the first equation to get 

$$
\begin{aligned}3{x}_{1}-8{x}_{2} & =-1 \\ 3{x}_{1}-8(2) & =-1 \\ 3{x}_{1} & =15 \\ {x}_{1} & =5.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we substitute ${x}_{1}=5$ and ${x}_{2}=2$ into the third equation to get

$$
\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2} & =-2 \\ -2(5)+4(2) & =-2 \\ -2 & =-2,\end{aligned}
$$

which gives a true statement. 

So the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=5$ and ${x}_{2}=2,$ which means

$$
5{a}_{1}+2{a}_{2}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=5+2=7.
$$
